commands:
set -eu

APP=/opt/citibike-dashboard
S3=s3://citi-bike-nyc-pipeline/scripts/dashboard

STAGE=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$STAGE"' EXIT

# Download updated files.
aws s3 cp "$S3/bedrock_sql.py" "$STAGE/bedrock_sql.py" --region us-east-2
aws s3 cp "$S3/redshift_schema.txt" "$STAGE/redshift_schema.txt" --region us-east-2

# Validate before modifying the running application.
python3 -m py_compile "$STAGE/bedrock_sql.py"
test -s "$STAGE/redshift_schema.txt"

# Back up previous versions.
BACKUP="$APP/backup-prompt-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP"

cp -p "$APP/bedrock_sql.py" "$BACKUP/"
cp -p "$APP/redshift_schema.txt" "$BACKUP/"

# Install new versions.
install -m 644 "$STAGE/bedrock_sql.py" "$APP/bedrock_sql.py"
install -m 644 "$STAGE/redshift_schema.txt" "$APP/redshift_schema.txt"

# Restart Streamlit.
systemctl restart citibike-dashboard.service
systemctl is-active citibike-dashboard.service

echo "Deployment successful."
echo "Backup location: $BACKUP"
